{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lethesk repair droid''' was a type of [[Maintenance droid/Legends|repair droid]]. It was a cheaply-made imitation of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]], which in turn caused Cybot Galactica to issue a lawsuit against this droid's manufacturers.<ref name="The Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
